paragraphs.en: All this time Dorothy and her companions had been walking through the thick woods. The road was still paved with yellow brick, but these were much covered by dried leaves and dead branches from the trees, and the walking was not at all good. There were few birds in this part of the forest, for birds love the open country where there is plenty of sunshine.
paragraphs.zh: 这一切时间多萝茜和她的伙伴们一直穿过密林行走着。道路依然由黄砖铺成，但这些极大地被树上干燥的叶子和枯枝所覆盖，步行一点也不好。森林的这个部分鸟儿极少，因为鸟儿热爱有着大量阳光的开阔乡村。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, a fearsome Lion bounded out from the forest, roaring loudly and knocking over the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman! But when the Lion snapped at little Toto, Dorothy stepped forward courageously and slapped his nose, crying: 'Don't you dare bite Toto! You ought to be ashamed of yourself, a big beast like you biting a poor little dog!'
paragraphs.zh: 突然，一只可怕的狮子从森林里跳了出来，大声咆哮着并撞倒了稻草人与铁皮木夫！但当狮子冲着小托托咬去时，多萝茜勇敢地跨上前去扇了他的鼻子，喊道：“你敢咬托托试一试！你应该为你自己感到羞愧，像你这样的大野兽咬一只可怜的小狗！”

paragraphs.en: The Lion began to weep, wiping his eyes with the tip of his tail: 'I know it,' he sobbed, 'but I can't help it! I am a coward, and whenever there is danger my heart beats fast.' The companions invited him to join their quest to ask Oz for courage, and the Lion gladly accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 狮子开始哭泣，用他的尾巴尖擦着双眼：“我知道，”他抽泣着，“但我没办法！我是个胆小鬼，每当有危险时我的心就跳得极快。”伙伴们邀请他加入他们的寻求去向奥兹要勇气，狮子欣然接受了。

paragraphs.en: The Yellow Brick Road wound onward through the magical countryside of Oz, flanked by sparkling brooks, colorful wild flowers, and strange golden trees. Dorothy tightly held Toto in her arms, her magical Silver Shoes sparkling with every step she took toward their goal.
paragraphs.zh: 黄砖路沿着奥兹国奇幻的乡村继续盘旋，两侧环绕着闪烁的小溪、绚丽的野花与神奇的金树。多萝茜把托托紧抱在怀里，她魔法银鞋在她朝目标迈出的每一步中都闪闪发光。

paragraphs.en: 'No matter how dreary our home in Kansas may be,' Dorothy remarked softly to the Scarecrow, 'we people of flesh and blood would rather live there than in any other country, be it ever so beautiful. There is no place like home.'
paragraphs.zh: '无论我们在堪萨斯的家多么沉闷，'多萝茜对稻草人软软地注意到，'我们血肉之躯的人们宁愿住在那里，也不愿住在任何其他国家（无论它多么美丽）。没有任何地方像家一样。'
